displayName: OCI-WSTG04-007: Weak Authentication — Basic Auth Over HTTP
description:
Detects HTTP Basic Authentication over unencrypted connections exposing credentials in cleartext

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: weak authentication — basic auth over http

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg04_007", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%weak%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%authentication%') AND "value" > 0
